commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

groupId.description: A group's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, kept in lowercase.

name.description: A group's name: 1 to 80 characters once trimmed, no control or format (zero-width) characters other than white space; stored trimmed with white space collapsed, unique per environment ignoring case.
